en: to cut out; to hollow out

examples.en: I cut out the rotten part of the apple with a knife.
Cut out the potato sprouts before cooking.
I cut out just the photo from the paper and pasted it.
The doctor said he cut out the bad part.
It was a pain like having my heart cut out.
I cut a coupon out of the magazine and took it along.

explain: 칼이나 가위로 일부를 둥글게 파내듯 잘라낼 때 써요. 그냥 '자르다'보다 안쪽 한 부분만 떼어 낸다는 느낌이 강해요. 아픔을 말할 때 '가슴을 도려내다'처럼 비유로도 써요.

phrases.example: 그 소식은 가슴을 도려내는 것처럼 아팠어요.
phrases.en: That news hurt as if my heart were being cut out.
phrases.nuance_ko: 실제로 자르는 것이 아니라 아주 큰 슬픔이나 아픔을 강하게 표현할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: It does not mean actual cutting; it strongly expresses deep sorrow or pain.

explain_en: It is used for cutting out a part with a knife or scissors, as if scooping it out. Compared with plain '자르다', it strongly suggests removing just one inner part. It is also used figuratively for pain, as in '가슴을 도려내다'.

examples.en: In winter, sailfin sandfish tastes good grilled.
I bought a box of sailfin sandfish at the market.

examples.ko: 도루묵은 알이 톡톡 터지는 느낌이 재미있어요.
examples.en: The way the roe pops in sailfin sandfish is fun.
My grandmother made braised sailfin sandfish for me.
A lot of sailfin sandfish is caught off the coast of Gangwon Province.
I tried sailfin sandfish stew for the first time, and it tasted clean and light.

explain: 생선 이름이라서 주로 음식 이야기에서 나와요. 구이나 찌개로 먹고, '말짱 도루묵'이라는 비유 표현에도 들어가요.

phrases.example: 열심히 준비했는데 행사가 취소돼서 말짱 도루묵이 됐어요.
phrases.en: I prepared hard, but the event was canceled, so it was all for nothing.
phrases.nuance_ko: 애쓴 일이 아무 소용없이 처음 상태로 돌아갔을 때 아쉬움을 담아 말해요. 편한 말투예요.
phrases.nuance_en: Said with regret when effort ends up wasted and you are back where you started. It is casual.
phrases.en_equiv: all for nothing; back to square one

explain_en: It is a fish name, so it mostly comes up when talking about food. People grill it or put it in stew, and it also appears in the figurative expression '말짱 도루묵'.

examples.en: I crush ice into small pieces with a blender.
I ground the coffee beans and put them in the filter.
The machine shredded the paper in an instant.

examples.ko: 이 장치는 음식물 쓰레기를 분쇄하는 기능이 있어요.
examples.en: This device has a function that grinds up food waste.

examples.ko: 필요 없는 서류는 분쇄한 뒤에 버려요.
examples.en: I throw away unneeded documents after shredding them.

examples.ko: 팀은 상대의 공격을 분쇄하고 첫 승을 거뒀어요.
examples.en: The team crushed the opponent's attack and won its first game.

explain: '부수다', '갈다'와 비슷하지만, '분쇄하다'는 기계로 가루나 작은 조각이 되게 할 때 많이 써요. '분쇄기', '분쇄 커피'처럼 붙여 쓰기도 해요. 계획이나 공격을 막아 없앤다는 뜻으로 뉴스에서 쓰기도 하지만, 일상 대화에서는 '깨다', '무너뜨리다'를 더 자주 말해요.
explain_en: It is close to '부수다' and '갈다', but '분쇄하다' is often used when a machine reduces something to powder or small pieces. It also appears in compounds like '분쇄기' (grinder/shredder) and '분쇄 커피' (ground coffee). In the news it can mean crushing a plan or attack, but in daily talk people more often say '깨다' or '무너뜨리다'.

examples.ko: 이 소고기는 육질이 부드러워서 아이들도 잘 먹어요.
examples.en: This beef is tender, so even kids eat it well.
I like chicken with a chewy texture.

examples.ko: 정육점 아저씨가 육질을 보고 고기를 골라 주셨어요.
examples.en: The butcher looked at the quality of the meat and picked some out for me.
Fish also has firm flesh when it's fresh.
Hanwoo beef is famous for its good meat quality.
If you cook it too long, the meat gets tough.

explain: 고기의 결과 질을 말할 때 써요. '식감'은 먹을 때 느끼는 느낌 전체이고, '육질'은 고기 자체의 상태예요. 소고기와 닭고기는 물론 생선살에도 써요.
explain_en: It describes the grain and quality of meat. '식감' is the overall feel when you eat, while '육질' is the condition of the meat itself. It is used for beef and chicken, and also for fish flesh.

examples.ko: 여러 재료를 조합해서 새 요리를 만들었어요.
examples.en: I made a new dish by combining several ingredients.

examples.ko: 색을 잘 조합하면 옷이 더 예뻐 보여요.
examples.en: If you combine colors well, the outfit looks prettier.

examples.ko: 숫자 네 개를 조합해 비밀번호를 만들어요.
examples.en: I make a password by combining four numbers.

examples.ko: 이 앱은 사진과 글을 조합할 수 있어요.
examples.en: This app lets you combine photos and text.

examples.ko: 단어를 조합해 문장을 만드는 연습을 했어요.
examples.en: We practiced making sentences by combining words.

examples.ko: 서로 다른 방법을 조합한 결과가 좋았어요.
examples.en: The result of combining different methods was good.

explain: '섞다'는 눈에 보이는 것을 그냥 섞는 느낌이고, '조합하다'는 정해진 요소들을 맞춰서 새것을 만드는 느낌이에요. 색, 숫자, 재료, 방법처럼 요소가 따로 있을 때 어울려요. 명사 '조합'은 '좋은 조합'처럼 어울리는 짝을 말할 때도 자주 써요.
explain_en: While 섞다 just means to mix, 조합하다 means putting set elements together to make something new, such as colors, numbers, ingredients or methods. The noun 조합 is also used for a good pairing, as in '좋은 조합'.

examples.ko: 과학 시간에 바닷물을 증류해서 소금을 분리했어요.
examples.en: In science class, we distilled seawater to separate out the salt.
If you distill water, the impurities are removed.

examples.ko: 이 기계는 해수를 증류해 마실 물을 만들어요.
examples.en: This machine distills seawater to make drinking water.

examples.ko: 먼저 액체를 끓인 다음 증기를 식혀서 증류해요.
examples.en: First you boil the liquid, then cool the steam to distill it.
I learned how to distill through an experiment.
They distill roses to make rose water.

explain: 그냥 '끓이다'와 달리, 끓어서 나온 증기를 다시 식혀 액체로 받아 내는 과정까지 포함해요. '증류수'라는 말이 일상에서 가장 흔하고, 동사는 과학 수업이나 설명에서 주로 써요.
explain_en: Unlike plain '끓이다' (to boil), it includes the step of cooling the steam and collecting it as a liquid again. The noun '증류수' (distilled water) is the most common form in daily life, while the verb is mainly used in science classes and explanations.

examples.en: My grandmother in the countryside sent me native honey.
Native honey is more expensive than regular honey.

examples.ko: 감기에 걸렸을 때 토종꿀을 따뜻한 물에 타 마셔요.
examples.en: When I have a cold, I mix native honey into warm water and drink it.

examples.ko: 이 토종꿀은 맛이 진하고 향이 좋아요.
examples.en: This native honey has a rich taste and a nice scent.
They say it's native honey collected directly in the mountains.
I bought a jar of native honey as a gift.

explain: '토종'은 그 땅에서 오래 자란 원래 품종이라는 뜻이라 '토종꿀'은 한국 토종벌이 만든 꿀을 말해요. 보통 양봉 꿀보다 귀하고 비싸다고 생각해서 선물로도 많이 줘요. 반대로 외국에서 들어온 종류는 '외래종'이라고 해요.
explain_en: '토종' refers to an original breed long native to the land, so '토종꿀' is honey made by native Korean bees. It is generally seen as rarer and pricier than farmed honey and is often given as a gift. The opposite, a species brought from abroad, is '외래종'.

examples.ko: 침 속에는 음식을 소화시키는 효소가 있어요.
examples.en: Saliva contains enzymes that digest food.

examples.ko: 요즘 효소 음료가 건강에 좋다고 인기예요.
examples.en: Enzyme drinks are popular these days as good for health.
We learned the role of enzymes in science class.

examples.ko: 파인애플에는 고기를 부드럽게 하는 효소가 들어 있어요.
examples.en: Pineapple has an enzyme that tenderizes meat.

examples.ko: 효소는 온도가 너무 높으면 일을 못 해요.
examples.en: Enzymes cannot work when the temperature is too high.
My grandmother makes plum enzyme syrup by herself.

explain: 과학 시간에 나오는 단어지만 한국에서는 '매실 효소', '곡물 효소'처럼 과일이나 곡물을 설탕에 재워 만든 건강 음료나 식품 이름으로도 자주 써요. 앞에 오는 말과 함께 '소화 효소'처럼 쓰는 경우가 많아요.
explain_en: A science-class word, but in Korea it is also commonly used for health drinks and foods made by steeping fruit or grain in sugar, as in '매실 효소' (plum enzyme syrup). It often appears in compounds such as '소화 효소' (digestive enzyme).
